tool.name: Event Calendar
tool.question: What scheduled events in the coming days and weeks could matter for crypto markets, and what just happened?

public_api.key_issuance: Request a free key with the feedback form on the site (type: Other). Keys are issued by hand, shown once, and expire after 365 days.

endpoints.summary: Upcoming events in the next 7, 30 or 90 days, with filters
Events whose scheduled time passed in the last days (short history)
One event with its change log (reschedules, cancellations)
Event load: count of high-importance events ahead, plus short daily history

datasets.attribution: AriB Research Event Calendar. Event data from the Federal Reserve, BLS, BEA, Deribit, Binance, go-ethereum, the Federal Register and Snapshot.
datasets.license_note: Personal and internal use. No redistribution or resale without written permission. Underlying US government schedules are in the public domain.
datasets.description: Dated, sourced events: macro releases, crypto options and futures expiries, Ethereum network upgrades, SEC/CFTC rulemaking deadlines, governance votes, owner-curated events. Each has a source link, a precision flag, a status and an importance level (a hypothesis).
datasets.frequency: checked every 30 minutes to 6 hours depending on the source
